title: Actual Q3 four-leg D(t) audit under an entire source weight
question: Does the candidate entire source weight w_sigma(a)=(1+|a|) exp(sigma |a|^4) absorb the actual Q3 local-weighted four-leg D(t) history across the declared finite amplitude and volume grid?

model.history: D_sigma(t,a)=U(H+sigma W_L,t) A_a U(H+sigma W_L,t)^* - U(H,t) A_a U(H,t)^*
model.normalized_quantity: sqrt(sum of four local weighted leg squares)/w_sigma(a)
model.comparison: The full shifted Hamiltonian weight is retained as a finite baseline; no global-K uniformity is assumed.

adversarial_review.check: The four-leg norm is divided by the declared scalar w_sigma(a), while the unnormalized values remain recorded; no square-versus-norm substitution is hidden.
K_X is applied as a matrix in the full-H representation and no commutation with rho or D is assumed.
The four amplitudes and finite volume/beta/cutoff grid are diagnostics only; no infinite source or volume limit is inferred.
The analytic rate and positive sigma margin are Lean-checked, but the actual Q3 word incidence and cancellations are not identified with the prescribed family.
Trace formulas reconstruct all four legs without inserting rho^(1/2), and row coverage is checked independently.
Common-core domain, source/volume uniformity, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

next_action: Use the normalized finite rows to decide whether the entire source weight is a viable common-core topology; if so, define the actual Q3 source seminorm and prove a six-neighbour, two-orientation, volume-uniform history bound before attempting exhaustion and QFT promotion.
no_overclaim: This package tests a candidate source-weight normalization on actual finite Q3 matrices. It does not prove an entire-source seminorm, a uniform common-core estimate, a thermodynamic QFT, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, or a Clay result.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks the exact rational entire-weight rate, margin, prefactor, and the norm-level normalization identity; Python checks actual Q3 matrices.

qft_interface.closed: Finite actual-Q3 local-weighted four-leg histories are normalized by the exact candidate entire source weight and independently reconstructed by trace formulas.
qft_interface.open: A source-, volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform source seminorm, modular-domain transfer, direct Cauchy, product/core density, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.
